rule: 60/20/20 of groups (round half to even), groups shuffled by numpy default_rng(seed)
group_key: the date in the name of the burn video
source: names of the PSI-26 videos in runs/dev/media/fabric/manifest_raw.jsonl (no video, track or outcome opened)
note: A burn whose video has no date in its name stays held. Tracks of test days are scored only in the final run.
